Crow setup

Step 1 of 2 · Create your app

Connect Crow to GitHub

Create a GitHub App so Crow can read pull requests and post reviews on your behalf.

GitHub will show the requested permissions and ask you to confirm. You will then choose which repositories Crow can access.

Create GitHub App

Keep your Crow setup terminal open while you complete these steps.

Crow setup

Step 2 of 2 · Choose repositories

Your GitHub App is ready

Install your app on GitHub and choose the repositories it can access.

Choose repositories on GitHub

Then return to your terminal and press Enter to continue setup.

You will choose which repositories Crow should review in the terminal.

Crow setup

Return to your terminal

This setup link is no longer valid

The link may have already been used, or it may belong to another setup session.

Check your Crow setup terminal for the next step. If setup has stopped, run

crow setup

to continue.

Crow setup

Return to your terminal

Could not finish connecting to GitHub

Crow could not complete the GitHub App registration.

Your Crow setup terminal has the error details. Resolve the issue there, then run

crow setup

to continue.
